title: Sign: chevrons-up (dots)
description: A sign for "top", drawn as dots.

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Sign, type SignProps } from "@/components/ui/sign"
import type { SignShape } from "@/lib/0db/sign-shapes"

const shape: SignShape = {
  "word": "top",
  "line": [
    [
      [
        "M",
        17,
        1
      ],
      [
        "L",
        18,
        -4
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "M",
        18,
        -4
      ],
      [
        "L",
        13,
        -9
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "M",
        17,
        18
      ],
      [
        "L",
        12,
        13
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "M",
        12,
        13
      ],
      [
        "L",
        7,
        18
      ]
    ]
  ]
}

function SignChevronsUpDots(props: Omit<SignProps, "shape" | "variant">) {
  return <Sign shape={shape} variant="dots" {...props} />
}

export { SignChevronsUpDots, shape }
